decisions.reason: The height-adjustable executive desk extends the firm's core office competence and fits the shift to flexible workplaces, so results likely stay near aspiration even though it has not been visible since 2019.
The chair family is close to the core offer and uses existing craft and distribution resources, so carrying it is cheap and gives little trigger for problemistic search.
With the related rug line already withdrawn, the carpet floor cushions lose their material and marketing synergy, likely fall short of aspirations, and free resources for the core business.
The soft sofa has low visibility, but it fits the core living range and benefited from pandemic-era home spending, so slack lets the firm keep it unless sales clearly miss aspirations.

Demand for the high standing table suffered during the pandemic office slump, but it is close to the established offer and fits the flexible-workplace direction, so the firm likely keeps it for the office recovery.
